Mia: Heads-up — launching SI Enablement playbook tomorrow 10am PT. Need final SME review + partner training slots. Draft link: https://redwood.in/s/si-enablement-draft :megaphone:

Raj: Thanks — I can take the 'deploy checklist' section. Can we include HW partner steps for GPU sizing?

Olivia: I'll review the curriculum and add a lab exercise for Dedicated + Private flows. ETA EOD today.

Ana: Sales will need the one-pager + battlecards. Can someone add expected deal triggers?

deploy-bot: New doc created: /docs/si-enablement/v1.2 — creator Mia

Mia: Solid. Quick checklist I'm proposing:
```
- SME review complete
- Train-the-trainer session scheduled (1.5h)
- Hands-on lab environment (cloud + on-prem notes)
- Certification exam draft
- Marketplace listing play ready
- Joint announcement draft reviewed by comms
```

Raj: Suggest adding 'hardware partner contact' and 'reference architecture for Inf1/GPU' to the checklist.

Olivia: Also add 'eval prompt set + regression metrics' — we've seen regressions when quantized models swapped.

Ana: For scheduling, 2x partner enablement slots next Wed/Thu at 11am PT? Works for enablement team.

Mia: Confirmed. I'll book and ping partners. @Olivia please drop the lab repo link when ready.

Olivia: Will do. Putting repo up now — https://git.redwood/sis/enablement-labs

Raj: I'll start drafting the certification question pool. Quick ask: do we want multiple choice + config tasks?

Ana: Both. MCQs for fundamentals, config tasks for hands-on verification.

Mia: Great. Final action items: Mia assign SME (Raj), Olivia builds lab, Ana builds sales assets, Comms to draft announcement. We'll run canary enablement with 2 SIs first. :rocket:

Olivia: noted.
